newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shutdowns depress DSM base and fine chemicals.
newsitem.headline: Shutdowns depress DSM base and fine chemicals.

text.p: Chemicals group DSM said on Wednesday operating profits at its industrial and fine chemicals business were depressed by maintenance shutdowns in caprolactam and melamine and a fall in fertilizers.
Higher selling prices for caprolactam, melamine and acrylonitrile, due in part to the higher dollar exchange rate, boosted year-on-year sales figures, it said in a statement.
But operating results for caprolactam and melamine were lower due to maintenance shutdowns and production outages.
Fertilizers booked sharply lower operating results due to lower sales prices and an overhaul of one of the ammonia plants.
Fine chemicals showed a "considerable increase" in both sales and operating profits, mainly due to acquisitions, higher selling prices and the strong dollar, DSM said.
However operating results for base and fine chemicals as a whole were down sharply at 183 million guilders from a year-earlier 314 million.
